_comment: The model-API requests the usage gateway forwards (PROTOCOL §2.11, D11; owner 2026-10-10, board 0072). Default deny: a
request is forwarded only if its host matches a provider here and its method and path are in that provider's list;
anything else is answered 403 and recorded (method and path, no body). A path is matched without its query string,
segment by segment (`*` = exactly one segment). The lists are what Codex and Claude Code sent in 738,826 recorded
requests of official runs (responses, models, messages, count_tokens) plus the Responses API's compaction call.
Not on any list, so refused: account connectors and apps, plugins, files, conversations, chat completions,
web search, images, audio, batches, assistants, token endpoints. `http` is the provider of a --http-host upstream.
_comment_tools: A model request may declare only tools the agent runs itself: no `type` (Anthropic's custom tools) or one of
client_tool_types (what Codex 0.160 and Claude Code 2.1 declared in every recorded request). Any other type is the
provider's: web search and fetch, image generation, remote MCP, file search, hosted shells and code interpreters.
provider_side_fields: top-level request fields that make the provider search the web, connect to a server, query
its own data sources, or take tools from a stored prompt. Chat completions are forwarded only to a --http-host
upstream (a self-hosted server): no recorded request of an official run used them, and at the providers that API
serves models that search the web without any tool declaration; list the path for a provider that needs it.
